notes: These are actual local executions on official released data, not contest-server submissions.
No test answers or private Potato embeddings are read by any solver. Scoring runs in separate parent processes.
Runtime starts before child process creation and includes imports, model/data loading, fitting, inference, file writing, and process exit. Scorer preparation and downloads are excluded.
Potato uses CPU only, BLAS 4 threads, and runs during another task's GPU work; OS file cache may be warm. No persistent solver feature cache.
Potato development uses 160 vocabulary words excluding official public targets and the public embedding judge. A/B were never used to tune parameters.
Potato .008 improved public-space development scores but did not materially generalize to released private-space A/B. Default .06 is retained.
Original official Potato baseline is included as a separate reference; before means repository baseline commit, not that official baseline.
Ghost pretrain 200 texts are all in train 1221, so they are not duplicated. Pretest 60 texts have no exact-text overlap with train.
Ghost evaluation uses fresh processes and recomputes all embeddings. The training-only tuning cache is never used for final run_seconds.

Ghost has exclusive use of the GPU; light concurrent CPU/file/download work may continue. GPU driver and OS file caches may be warm. Each model is loaded into a fresh process; this is not a cold-machine benchmark.

Ghost had two native failures: length-bucketed pretest and original-loop C10/prior0 B. Both exited 3221226505 (0xC0000409) before an embedding-completion/validation log, with no Python traceback. Cause unconfirmed; neither length sorting nor C is established as the cause. All runs retained, candidates not adopted, baseline C2/prior.25 restored.

An additional fresh-process baseline B stability run passed at the identical 90.80969023066716 score in 83.375 seconds. Baseline has four successful runs total; B was measured twice. This does not establish the cause of the native candidate failures.
Paths are sanitized. Full per-game logs, prediction files, and unredacted run records remain in the local work directory.
